scope: Observed fixed-point instability on archived annulus inputs. No physical accuracy qualification; no product solver or default control changed.

limitations: Power iteration is not a complete spectrum or a general spectral bound.
Diffusion-only change threshold does not certify coupled momentum/continuity or physical accuracy.
Fine Stokes fails without inertia; convection is not necessary for this failure.
Pressure inner nonorthogonal map is noncontractive, but stabilizing it alone did not repair the full outer map.
The shifted full map retains a near-real growing mode; scalar whole-state damping did not fix the observed instability.
Mesh/reconstruction geometry is not exonerated; the exact responsible coefficient pattern and general accuracy-preserving repair are still unresolved.
